about: The character object of the server. NeedsUpdate and ForceSynch keep a character awake far from the party; Flags3 holds SpreadActivation; UserID is the user who controls it and the second user id at +0x188 the user it is reserved for. Script Extender: ServerCharacter.

evidence.says: the header Character.h of Script Extender binds ServerCharacter to this engine name; the offsets are from its layout (gatekit symbols layout)

on the host ServerCharacter.ForceSynch reads 0, then 1 right after Osi.SetForceUpdate(host, 1) and 0 after Osi.SetForceUpdate(host, 0), NeedsUpdate staying 0; UserID and UserID2 both read 65537, the user of the host

the handler of the Osiris call StartChangeAppearance (bg3_dx11.exe+0x36AD7A0) compares the int at +0x188 of the character it resolved with the unassigned user id, where the Toolkit function of the same name calls esv::Character::GetReservedForUserID
